High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Yoxgit (V) (Errata 3)]] (Virtual Set 9, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 9/Light/Yoxgit.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/13H8apX6t3Q2HeXA3qUkE4_j3CP-KL62K/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Yoxgit.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,343,688 bytes, SHA-256 <code>dbec371467d64309113663d7181d44ea34715b0030718792319f28396891804e</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V9-L-yoxgit.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
